notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. Deep sanitation pass: production Logcat is now fully silent — user prompts, agent output, environment variable names and provider error bodies can no longer be written to the system log in release builds (debug builds keep full logging). The voice recognizer is released immediately after every final result instead of being held open, and the agent chat voice language now persists across restarts and stays in sync with the Sidekick assistant language setting. Existing tools untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU/PTY terminal + terminal keyboard, Phone Control (Shizuku/Wireless ADB/root), in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
